description: The one-line install command for a skill in a given agent, the repository it installs from, where it lands, and its page on aiqbench. Name the skill by the id find_skills gave, owner/repo/skill, its page link, or its name. Several skills share a name: a bare name returns a known vendor's skill of that name when there is one, else the best-trusted, with ambiguous: true and the other repositories' skills under alternatives; tell the user which repository the command installs from. An unknown name is an error (isError) with didYouMean.
name: install_command
title: Install command for a skill
